To reflect the evolving objectives of image super-resolution, the challenge includes two tracks: (1) a restoration track, which emphasizes pixel-wise fidelity and ranks submissions based on PSNR; and (2) a perceptual track, which focuses on visual realism and evaluates results using a perceptual score. A total of 194 participants registered for the challenge, with 31 teams submitting valid entries. This report summarizes the challenge design, datasets, evaluation protocol, main results, and methods of participating teams. The challenge provides a unified benchmark and offers insights into current progress and future directions in image super-resolution.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026图像超分辨率挑战赛报告，包含两个赛道：基于PSNR的恢复赛道和基于感知质量的感知赛道，共194名参与者注册，31个团队提交有效方案。
AI.motivation: 为图像超分辨率领域提供统一的基准测试平台，分析该领域的最新进展，反映超分辨率技术从像素级保真度到视觉真实性的演进目标。
AI.method: 挑战赛设计包含两个独立赛道：1) 恢复赛道：强调像素级保真度，使用PSNR作为排名标准；2) 感知赛道：关注视觉真实性，使用感知分数进行评估。采用双三次下采样生成×4缩放的低分辨率图像作为输入。
AI.result: 共有194名参与者注册，31个团队提交了有效解决方案。挑战赛成功建立了统一的评估基准，并展示了当前图像超分辨率领域的技术进展。
AI.conclusion: NTIRE 2026超分辨率挑战赛为领域提供了重要的基准测试平台，揭示了当前技术进展，并为未来研究方向提供了有价值的见解。

title: DockAnywhere: Data-Efficient Visuomotor Policy Learning for Mobile Manipulation via Novel Demonstration Generation
summary: Mobile manipulation is a fundamental capability that enables robots to interact in expansive environments such as homes and factories. Most existing approaches follow a two-stage paradigm, where the robot first navigates to a docking point and then performs fixed-base manipulation using powerful visuomotor policies. However, real-world mobile manipulation often suffers from the view generalization problem due to shifts of docking points. To address this issue, we propose a novel low-cost demonstration generation framework named DockAnywhere, which improves viewpoint generalization under docking variability by lifting a single demonstration to diverse feasible docking configurations. Specifically, DockAnywhere lifts a trajectory to any feasible docking points by decoupling docking-dependent base motions from contact-rich manipulation skills that remain invariant across viewpoints. Feasible docking proposals are sampled under feasibility constraints, and corresponding trajectories are generated via structure-preserving augmentation. Visual observations are synthesized in 3D space by representing the robot and objects as point clouds and applying point-level spatial editing to ensure the consistency of observation and action across viewpoints. Extensive experiments on ManiSkill and real-world platforms demonstrate that DockAnywhere substantially improves policy success rates and easily generalizes to novel viewpoints from unseen docking points during training, significantly enhancing the generalization capability of mobile manipulation policy in real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: DockAnywhere框架通过解耦基座运动与操作技能，将单次演示提升到多样化的可行对接配置，解决了移动操作中的视角泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有移动操作方法采用两阶段范式（先导航到对接点，再进行固定基座操作），但在实际部署中因对接点变化导致视角泛化问题，限制了策略的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出DockAnywhere框架：1) 解耦依赖于对接的基座运动与跨视角不变的接触式操作技能；2) 在可行性约束下采样可行对接点；3) 通过结构保持增强生成对应轨迹；4) 使用点云表示机器人和物体，通过点级空间编辑合成3D空间中的视觉观测。
AI.result: 在ManiSkill和真实平台上的大量实验表明，DockAnywhere显著提高了策略成功率，并能轻松泛化到训练中未见对接点的新视角，大幅增强了移动操作策略在真实世界部署中的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DockAnywhere通过解耦基座运动与操作技能，实现了从单次演示到多样化对接配置的提升，有效解决了移动操作中的视角泛化问题，为真实世界移动操作部署提供了低成本、高泛化的解决方案。

title: Pushing the Limits of On-Device Streaming ASR: A Compact, High-Accuracy English Model for Low-Latency Inference
summary: Deploying high-quality automatic speech recognition (ASR) on edge devices requires models that jointly optimize accuracy, latency, and memory footprint while operating entirely on CPU without GPU acceleration. We conduct a systematic empirical study of state-of-the-art ASR architectures, encompassing encoder-decoder, transducer, and LLM-based paradigms, evaluated across batch, chunked, and streaming inference modes. Through a comprehensive benchmark of over 50 configurations spanning OpenAI Whisper, NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet TDT, Canary, Conformer Transducer, and Qwen3-ASR, we identify NVIDIA's Nemotron Speech Streaming as the strongest candidate for real-time English streaming on resource-constrained hardware. We then re-implement the complete streaming inference pipeline in ONNX Runtime and conduct a controlled evaluation of multiple post-training quantization strategies, including importance-weighted k-quant, mixed-precision schemes, and round-to-nearest quantization, combined with graph-level operator fusion. These optimizations reduce the model from 2.47 GB to as little as 0.67 GB while maintaining word error rate (WER) within 1% absolute of the full-precision PyTorch baseline. Our recommended configuration, the int4 k-quant variant, achieves 8.20% average streaming WER across eight standard benchmarks, running comfortably faster than real-time on CPU with 0.56 s algorithmic latency, establishing a new quality-efficiency Pareto point for on-device streaming ASR.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了多种ASR架构在边缘设备上的性能，发现NVIDIA Nemotron Speech Streaming最适合实时英语流式识别，并通过量化优化将模型从2.47GB压缩至0.67GB，同时保持WER在基线1%以内。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备上部署高质量ASR需要模型在CPU上同时优化准确性、延迟和内存占用，而无需GPU加速。现有研究缺乏对不同ASR架构在资源受限硬件上的系统性比较。
AI.method: 1. 系统评估了超过50种配置的ASR架构，包括编码器-解码器、转换器和基于LLM的范式，涵盖批量、分块和流式推理模式；2. 在ONNX Runtime中重新实现完整的流式推理管道；3. 评估多种训练后量化策略，包括重要性加权k-quant、混合精度方案和最近舍入量化，结合图级算子融合。
AI.result: 1. NVIDIA Nemotron Speech Streaming被确定为资源受限硬件上实时英语流式识别的最佳候选；2. 量化优化将模型从2.47GB压缩至0.67GB，同时保持WER在完整精度PyTorch基线的1%绝对误差内；3. 推荐的int4 k-quant变体在八个标准基准测试中实现8.20%的平均流式WER，在CPU上以0.56秒算法延迟舒适地快于实时。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过系统评估和量化优化，为设备端流式ASR建立了一个新的质量-效率帕累托点，证明了在资源受限边缘设备上部署高质量ASR的可行性。

title: CAVERS: Multimodal SLAM Data from a Natural Karstic Cave with Ground Truth Motion Capture
summary: Autonomous robots operating in natural karstic caves face perception and navigation challenges that are qualitatively distinct from those encountered in mines or tunnels: irregular geometry, reflective wet surfaces, near-zero ambient light, and complex branching passages. Yet publicly available datasets targeting this environment remain scarce and offer limited sensing modalities and environmental diversity. We present CAVERS, a multimodal dataset acquired in two structurally distinct rooms of Cueva de la Victoria, Málaga, Spain, comprising 24 sequences totaling approximately 335 GB of recorded data. The sensor suite combines an Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D-I camera, an Optris PI640i near-IR thermal camera, and a Velodyne VLP-16 LiDAR, operated both handheld and mounted on a wheeled rover under full darkness and artificial illumination. For most of the sequences, mm-accurate 6-DoF ground truth pose and velocity at 120 Hz are provided by an Optirack motion capture system installed directly inside the cave. We benchmark seven state-of-the-art SLAM and odometry algorithms spanning visual, visual-inertial, thermal-inertial, and LiDAR-based pipelines, as well as a 3D reconstruction pipeline, demonstrating the dataset's usability. %The dataset and all supplementary material are publicly available at: https://github.com/spaceuma/cavers.

AI.tldr: CAVERS是一个针对自然喀斯特洞穴环境的多模态数据集，包含RGB-D-I、热红外和LiDAR数据，提供毫米级精度的地面真实位姿，用于评估SLAM和里程计算法。
AI.motivation: 自然喀斯特洞穴环境（不规则几何、湿滑反射表面、近零环境光、复杂分支通道）对自主机器人感知和导航提出了独特挑战，但现有公开数据集稀缺且模态有限，缺乏环境多样性。
AI.method: 在西班牙马拉加的Cueva de la Victoria洞穴两个结构不同的房间中采集数据，包含24个序列（约335GB）。传感器套件包括Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D-I相机、Optris PI640i近红外热成像相机和Velodyne VLP-16 LiDAR，采用手持和轮式机器人两种方式，在全黑暗和人工照明条件下操作。使用Optirack运动捕捉系统提供120Hz毫米级精度的6自由度位姿和速度地面真实值。
AI.result: 创建了CAVERS数据集，对七种最先进的SLAM和里程计算法（视觉、视觉-惯性、热-惯性和LiDAR）以及3D重建流程进行了基准测试，证明了数据集的可用性。
AI.conclusion: CAVERS填补了自然喀斯特洞穴环境多模态数据集的空白，提供了高质量的地面真实数据，可用于评估和开发在极端地下环境中鲁棒的感知和导航算法。

title: Revisiting Token Compression for Accelerating ViT-based Sparse Multi-View 3D Object Detectors
summary: Vision Transformer (ViT)-based sparse multi-view 3D object detectors have achieved remarkable accuracy but still suffer from high inference latency due to heavy token processing. To accelerate these models, token compression has been widely explored. However, our revisit of existing strategies, such as token pruning, merging, and patch size enlargement, reveals that they often discard informative background cues, disrupt contextual consistency, and lose fine-grained semantics, negatively affecting 3D detection. To overcome these limitations, we propose SEPatch3D, a novel framework that dynamically adjusts patch sizes while preserving critical semantic information within coarse patches. Specifically, we design Spatiotemporal-aware Patch Size Selection (SPSS) that assigns small patches to scenes containing nearby objects to preserve fine details and large patches to background-dominated scenes to reduce computation cost. To further mitigate potential detail loss, Informative Patch Selection (IPS) selects the informative patches for feature refinement, and Cross-Granularity Feature Enhancement (CGFE) injects fine-grained details into selected coarse patches, enriching semantic features. Experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 validation sets show that SEPatch3D achieves up to \textbf{57\%} faster inference than the StreamPETR baseline and \textbf{20\%} higher efficiency than the state-of-the-art ToC3D-faster, while preserving comparable detection accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Mingqj/SEPatch3D.

AI.tldr: SEPatch3D：一种动态调整ViT补丁大小的稀疏多视图3D目标检测框架，通过时空感知补丁大小选择、信息补丁选择和跨粒度特征增强，在保持检测精度的同时显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有ViT稀疏多视图3D目标检测器推理延迟高，传统token压缩方法（如token剪枝、合并、增大补丁尺寸）会丢弃信息背景线索、破坏上下文一致性并丢失细粒度语义，影响3D检测性能。
AI.method: 提出SEPatch3D框架：1) 时空感知补丁大小选择(SPSS)：根据场景内容动态分配补丁大小，对包含近处物体的场景使用小补丁保留细节，对背景主导场景使用大补丁减少计算；2) 信息补丁选择(IPS)：选择信息丰富的补丁进行特征细化；3) 跨粒度特征增强(CGFE)：将细粒度细节注入选定的粗粒度补丁，丰富语义特征。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2验证集上，SEPatch3D比StreamPETR基线推理速度快57%，比最先进的ToC3D-faster效率高20%，同时保持可比的检测精度。
AI.conclusion: SEPatch3D通过动态调整补丁大小并保留关键语义信息，有效解决了现有token压缩方法的局限性，在显著加速推理的同时保持了3D检测精度，为高效稀疏多视图3D目标检测提供了新思路。

title: Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation
summary:
Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. We formalize synthetic augmentation as a modification of the effective training distribution and show that it induces a structural bias--variance trade-off: while additional samples may reduce estimation error, they may also shift the population objective whenever the synthetic distribution deviates from regions relevant under evaluation. To isolate informational gains from mechanical sample-size effects, we introduce a size-matched null augmentation and a finite-sample, non-parametric block permutation test that remains valid under weak temporal dependence.
  We evaluate this framework in both controlled Markov-switching environments and real financial datasets, including high-frequency option trade data and a daily equity panel. Across generators spanning bootstrap, copula-based models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, and TimeGAN, we vary augmentation ratio, model capacity, task type, regime rarity, and signal-to-noise. We show that synthetic augmentation is beneficial only in variance-dominant regimes, such as persistent volatility forecasting-while it deteriorates performance in bias-dominant settings, including near-efficient directional prediction. Rare-regime targeting can improve domain-specific metrics but may conflict with unconditional permutation inference. Our results provide a structural perspective on when synthetic data improves financial learning performance and when it induces persistent distributional distortion.

AI.tldr: 该研究形式化分析了金融机器学习中合成数据增强的统计效应，揭示了其引发的结构偏差-方差权衡，并提出了匹配样本量的零增强方法和块置换检验来区分信息增益与机械样本量效应。
AI.motivation: 合成数据增强在金融机器学习中日益用于缓解数据稀缺问题，但其统计作用尚不明确。研究者希望理解合成增强何时能真正改善学习性能，何时会导致分布失真，从而为金融应用提供理论指导。
AI.method: 将合成增强形式化为训练分布的有效修改，引入大小匹配的零增强来隔离信息增益与机械样本量效应，开发了有限样本、非参数的块置换检验方法，并在受控马尔可夫切换环境和真实金融数据集（高频期权交易数据和日频股票面板）上进行评估。
AI.result: 研究发现合成增强仅在方差主导的机制中（如持续性波动率预测）有益，而在偏差主导的设置中（如接近有效的方向预测）会恶化性能。罕见机制定向可以改善特定领域指标，但可能与无条件置换推断相冲突。评估了多种生成器（bootstrap、基于copula的模型、变分自编码器、扩散模型、TimeGAN）在不同增强比例、模型容量、任务类型、机制稀有度和信噪比下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据增强在金融学习中存在结构性的偏差-方差权衡，只有在方差主导的机制中才能改善性能，而在偏差主导的设置中会导致性能下降。研究提供了关于何时合成数据能真正提升金融学习性能，何时会引发持续分布失真的结构性视角。

title: Trajectory Planning for a Multi-UAV Rigid-Payload Cascaded Transportation System Based on Enhanced Tube-RRT*
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (TAES). This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper presents a two-stage trajectory planning framework for a multi-UAV rigid-payload cascaded transportation system, aiming to address planning challenges in densely cluttered environments. In Stage I, an Enhanced Tube-RRT* algorithm is developed by integrating active hybrid sampling and an adaptive expansion strategy, enabling rapid generation of a safe and feasible virtual tube in environments with dense obstacles. Moreover, a trajectory smoothness cost is explicitly incorporated into the edge cost to reduce excessive turns and thereby mitigate cable-induced oscillations. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed Enhanced Tube-RRT* achieves a higher success rate and effective sampling rate than mixed-sampling Tube-RRT* (STube-RRT*) and adaptive-extension Tube-RRT* (AETube-RRT*), while producing a shorter optimal path with a smaller cumulative turning angle. In Stage II, a convex quadratic program is formulated by considering payload translational and rotational dynamics, cable tension constraints, and collision-safety constraints, yielding a smooth, collision-free desired payload trajectory. Finally, a centralized geometric control scheme is applied to the cascaded system to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed planning framework, offering a practical solution for payload attitude maneuvering in densely cluttered environments.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段轨迹规划框架用于多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统，解决密集障碍环境中的规划挑战。第一阶段开发增强型Tube-RRT*算法，第二阶段制定凸二次规划，最终通过集中几何控制验证框架有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统在密集障碍环境中的轨迹规划挑战，特别是处理电缆引起的振荡和碰撞安全问题，为实际应用提供可行解决方案。
AI.method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段开发增强型Tube-RRT*算法，集成主动混合采样和自适应扩展策略，并加入轨迹平滑度成本；第二阶段制定凸二次规划，考虑负载平移旋转动力学、电缆张力约束和碰撞安全约束；最后应用集中几何控制方案。
AI.result: 增强型Tube-RRT*相比混合采样Tube-RRT*和自适应扩展Tube-RRT*具有更高成功率和有效采样率，产生更短最优路径和更小累积转弯角度；凸二次规划生成平滑无碰撞的期望负载轨迹；集中控制验证了框架的有效性和可行性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的两阶段轨迹规划框架为多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统在密集障碍环境中提供了有效的解决方案，能够处理电缆引起的振荡和碰撞安全问题，具有实际应用价值。

title: Learning Adaptive Reasoning Paths for Efficient Visual Reasoning
summary: Visual reasoning models (VRMs) have recently shown strong cross-modal reasoning capabilities by integrating visual perception with language reasoning. However, they often suffer from overthinking, producing unnecessarily long reasoning chains for any tasks. We attribute this issue to \textbf{Reasoning Path Redundancy} in visual reasoning: many visual questions do not require the full reasoning process. To address this, we propose \textbf{AVR}, an adaptive visual reasoning framework that decomposes visual reasoning into three cognitive functions: visual perception, logical reasoning, and answer application. It further enables models to dynamically choose among three response formats: Full Format, Perception-Only Format, and Direct Answer. AVR is trained with FS-GRPO, an adaptation of Group Relative Policy Optimization that encourages the model to select the most efficient reasoning format while preserving correctness. Experiments on multiple vision-language benchmarks show that AVR reduces token usage by 50--90\% while maintaining overall accuracy, especially in perception-intensive tasks. These results demonstrate that adaptive visual reasoning can effectively mitigate overthinking in VRMs. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/RunRiotComeOn/AVR.

AI.tldr: AVR提出自适应视觉推理框架，通过分解认知功能并动态选择响应格式，减少VRM中的过度思考问题，显著降低token使用量
AI.motivation: 现有视觉推理模型存在过度思考问题，对任何任务都产生不必要的长推理链，导致推理路径冗余，需要更高效的推理框架
AI.method: 提出AVR框架，将视觉推理分解为视觉感知、逻辑推理和答案应用三个认知功能，并动态选择三种响应格式：完整格式、仅感知格式和直接答案格式，使用FS-GRPO训练方法
AI.result: 在多个视觉语言基准测试中，AVR将token使用量减少50-90%，同时保持整体准确性，特别是在感知密集型任务中表现优异
AI.conclusion: 自适应视觉推理能有效缓解视觉推理模型中的过度思考问题，通过动态选择最有效的推理格式实现高效推理

title: Geometric Metrics for MoE Specialization: From Fisher Information to Early Failure Detection
summary: Expert specialization is fundamental to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model success, yet existing metrics (cosine similarity, routing entropy) lack theoretical grounding and yield inconsistent conclusions under reparameterization. We present an information-geometric framework providing the first rigorous characterization of MoE specialization dynamics. Our key insight is that expert routing distributions evolve on the probability simplex equipped with the Fisher information metric, enabling formal analysis via Riemannian geometry. We prove that standard heuristic metrics violate parameterization invariance (Theorem 1), establish that specialization corresponds to geodesic flow with quantified approximation bounds (Theorem 2), and derive a failure predictor with theoretical threshold justification (Theorem 3). The framework introduces two principled metrics: Fisher Specialization Index (FSI) achieving r=0.91+/-0.02 correlation with downstream performance, and Fisher Heterogeneity Score (FHS) predicting training failure at 10% completion with AUC=0.89+/-0.03 -- outperforming validation-loss-based early stopping by 23% while requiring 40x fewer compute cycles. We validate intervention protocols achieving 87% recovery rate when FHS>1 is detected. Comprehensive experiments across language modeling (WikiText-103, C4), vision MoE (ImageNet), and scaling studies (8-64 experts, 125M-2.7B parameters) validate our theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个信息几何框架，首次为MoE模型中的专家专业化提供了严格的理论基础，解决了现有启发式指标缺乏理论依据和参数化不变性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有衡量MoE专家专业化的指标（如余弦相似度、路由熵）缺乏理论基础，在不同参数化下会得出不一致的结论，需要建立严格的理论框架来分析和量化专家专业化动态。
AI.method: 采用信息几何框架，将专家路由分布视为概率单纯形上的演化，利用Fisher信息度量和黎曼几何进行形式化分析。提出了两个原则性指标：Fisher专业化指数(FSI)和Fisher异质性分数(FHS)。
AI.result: FSI与下游性能的相关性达到r=0.91±0.02；FHS在训练完成10%时就能预测失败，AUC=0.89±0.03，比基于验证损失的早停方法提升23%，同时减少40倍计算周期。干预协议在FHS>1时的恢复率达到87%。
AI.conclusion: 该信息几何框架为MoE专业化动态提供了首个严格的理论基础，提出的原则性指标在语言建模、视觉MoE和扩展研究中得到验证，显著优于现有启发式方法，并为训练失败预测和干预提供了理论依据。

title: Deepfake Detection Generalization with Diffusion Noise
summary: Deepfake detectors face growing challenges in generalization as new image synthesis techniques emerge. In particular, deepfakes generated by diffusion models are highly photorealistic and often evade detectors trained on GAN-based forgeries. This paper addresses the generalization problem in deepfake detection by leveraging diffusion noise characteristics. We propose an Attention-guided Noise Learning (ANL) framework that integrates a pre-trained diffusion model into the deepfake detection pipeline to guide the learning of more robust features. Specifically, our method uses the diffusion model's denoising process to expose subtle artifacts: the detector is trained to predict the noise contained in an input image at a given diffusion step, forcing it to capture discrepancies between real and synthetic images, while an attention-guided mechanism derived from the predicted noise is introduced to encourage the model to focus on globally distributed discrepancies rather than local patterns. By harnessing the frozen diffusion model's learned distribution of natural images, the ANL method acts as a form of regularization, improving the detector's generalization to unseen forgery types. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ANL significantly outperforms existing methods on multiple benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy in detecting diffusion-generated deepfakes. Notably, the proposed framework boosts generalization performance (e.g., improving ACC/AP by a substantial margin on unseen models) without introducing additional overhead during inference. Our results highlight that diffusion noise provides a powerful signal for generalizable deepfake detection.

AI.tldr: 提出ANL框架，利用扩散模型的噪声特征提升深度伪造检测的泛化能力，通过注意力引导的噪声学习捕获真实与合成图像的差异
AI.motivation: 随着扩散模型等新图像合成技术的出现，深度伪造检测器面临泛化能力不足的挑战，特别是扩散模型生成的深度伪造具有高度真实感，能够逃避基于GAN伪造训练的检测器
AI.method: 提出注意力引导噪声学习(ANL)框架，将预训练扩散模型集成到深度伪造检测流程中，指导学习更鲁棒的特征。具体方法：1)利用扩散模型去噪过程暴露细微伪影；2)训练检测器预测给定扩散步长下输入图像中的噪声，迫使其捕获真实与合成图像的差异；3)引入基于预测噪声的注意力引导机制，使模型关注全局分布的差异而非局部模式
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，在检测扩散生成的深度伪造方面达到最先进准确率。ANL显著提升泛化性能（如在未见模型上大幅提高ACC/AP），且推理时不引入额外开销
AI.conclusion: 扩散噪声为可泛化的深度伪造检测提供了强大信号，ANL框架通过利用冻结扩散模型学习到的自然图像分布作为正则化形式，有效提升检测器对未见伪造类型的泛化能力

title: Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities
summary: Healthcare disparities persist across socioeconomic boundaries, often attributed to unequal access to screening, diagnostics, and therapeutics. However, this perspective highlights that critical biases can emerge much earlier, during data collection and research prioritization, long before clinical implementation in cases where the focus of the studies and the data that is collected is at the molecular level. A vast number of studies focus on collecting omics data but the demographic information associated with these datasets is often not reported in the studies, and when it is reported, it shows big biases. An automated analysis of 4719 PubMed-indexed omics publications from 2015 to 2024 reveals that only a small fraction report ancestry or ethnicity information, with ancestry reporting improving slightly. Analysis of large-scale datasets commonly used for model training, such as CellxGene and GEO, reveals substantial population bias where European-ancestry data dominates. As biomedical foundation models become central to biomedical discovery with a paradigm in which base models are pretrained on large datasets and reusing them time and again for many different downstream tasks, they risk perpetuating or amplifying these early-stage biases, leading to cascading inequities that regulatory interventions cannot fully reverse. We propose a community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Evaluation Transparency to improve equity and robustness in biomedical AI. This approach aims to foster biomedical innovation that more effectively serves underserved populations and improves health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文通过分析4719篇组学文献和大型数据集，揭示了生物医学研究中早期数据收集阶段存在严重的人口统计偏倚，欧洲血统数据占主导，且人口信息报告不足，这可能导致生物医学基础模型放大不平等。
AI.motivation: 当前医疗不平等常归因于筛查、诊断和治疗的可及性差异，但本文指出关键偏倚在更早的数据收集和研究优先化阶段就已产生。组学研究大量收集分子数据，但相关人口统计信息报告不足或存在严重偏倚，这可能在生物医学基础模型时代导致系统性不平等被固化甚至放大。
AI.method: 对2015-2024年PubMed索引的4719篇组学出版物进行自动化分析，评估其祖先/种族信息报告情况；分析CellxGene和GEO等常用于模型训练的大规模数据集，评估其人口构成偏倚；提出基于三个基本原则（来源、开放性和评估透明度）的社区框架。
AI.result: 分析显示：1）只有一小部分组学出版物报告祖先或种族信息，祖先报告略有改善；2）常用数据集存在显著人口偏倚，欧洲血统数据占主导地位；3）在基础模型预训练和重复使用的范式下，这些早期偏倚可能被固化和放大，导致监管干预难以逆转的级联不平等。
AI.conclusion: 为解决生物医学AI中的公平性和鲁棒性问题，需要社区范围内关注三个基本原则：来源（Provenance）、开放性（Openness）和评估透明度（Evaluation Transparency）。这一方法旨在促进更有效服务未充分服务人群、改善健康结果的生物医学创新。

title: Dual Pose-Graph Semantic Localization for Vision-Based Autonomous Drone Racing
summary: Autonomous drone racing demands robust real-time localization under extreme conditions: high-speed flight, aggressive maneuvers, and payload-constrained platforms that often rely on a single camera for perception. Existing visual SLAM systems, while effective in general scenarios, struggle with motion blur and feature instability inherent to racing dynamics, and do not exploit the structured nature of racing environments. In this work, we present a dual pose-graph architecture that fuses odometry with semantic detections for robust localization. A temporary graph accumulates multiple gate observations between keyframes and optimizes them into a single refined constraint per landmark, which is then promoted to a persistent main graph. This design preserves the information richness of frequent detections while preventing graph growth from degrading real-time performance. The system is designed to be sensor-agnostic, although in this work we validate it using monocular visual-inertial odometry and visual gate detections. Experimental evaluation on the TII-RATM dataset shows a 56% to 74% reduction in ATE compared to standalone VIO, while an ablation study confirms that the dual-graph architecture achieves 10% to 12% higher accuracy than a single-graph baseline at identical computational cost. Deployment in the A2RL competition demonstrated that the system performs real-time onboard localization during flight, reducing the drift of the odometry baseline by up to 4.2 m per lap.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于自主无人机竞速的双位姿图架构，融合里程计与语义检测，通过临时图累积多个门检测并优化为单个约束，再提升到主图中，在保持检测信息丰富性的同时避免图增长影响实时性能。
AI.motivation: 自主无人机竞速需要在高速飞行、剧烈机动和载荷受限条件下实现鲁棒的实时定位。现有视觉SLAM系统在竞速场景中面临运动模糊和特征不稳定问题，且未充分利用竞速环境的结构化特性。
AI.method: 采用双位姿图架构：临时图在关键帧之间累积多个门检测，优化为每个地标的单个精炼约束，然后提升到持久的主图中。系统设计为传感器无关，本文使用单目视觉惯性里程计和视觉门检测进行验证。
AI.result: 在TII-RATM数据集上，相比独立VIO，ATE减少56%至74%。消融研究表明，在相同计算成本下，双图架构比单图基线精度提高10%至12%。在A2RL竞赛中部署显示系统能实时进行机载定位，每圈减少里程计基线漂移达4.2米。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双位姿图架构有效解决了自主无人机竞速中的定位挑战，通过融合里程计与语义检测，在保持实时性能的同时显著提高了定位精度和鲁棒性。

title: Mind DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present \textbf{Mind DeepResearch (MindDR)}, an efficient multi-agent deep research framework that achieves leading performance with only \textasciitilde30B-parameter models through a meticulously designed data synthesis and multi-stage training pipeline. The core innovation of MindDR lies in a collaborative three-agent architecture (Planning Agent, DeepSearch Agent, and Report Agent) and a four-stage agent-specialized training pipeline comprising SFT cold-start, Search-RL, Report-RL and preference alignment. With this regime, MindDR demonstrates competitive performance even with \textasciitilde30B-scale models. Specifically, MindDR achieves 45.7\% on BrowseComp-ZH, 42.8\% on BrowseComp, 46.5\% on WideSearch, 75.0\% on xbench-DS, and 52.5 on DeepResearch Bench, outperforming comparable-scale open-source agent systems and rivaling larger-scale models. MindDR has been deployed as an online product in Li Auto. Furthermore, we introduce \textbf{MindDR Bench}, a curated benchmark of 500 real-world Chinese queries from our internal product user interactions, evaluated through a comprehensive multi-dimensional rubric system rather than relying on a single RACE metric. On MindDR Bench, MindDR achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.8.

AI.tldr: MindDR是一个高效的多智能体深度研究框架，通过约30B参数模型实现领先性能，采用精心设计的数据合成和多阶段训练流程，包含三个协作智能体和四阶段训练，在多个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 开发一个高效的深度研究框架，能够在相对较小的模型规模（约30B参数）下实现竞争性性能，解决现有大型模型资源消耗高的问题，并提供实际产品部署能力。
AI.method: 采用三智能体协作架构（规划智能体、深度搜索智能体、报告智能体）和四阶段训练流程：SFT冷启动、搜索强化学习、报告强化学习和偏好对齐。同时引入了MindDR Bench基准测试，包含500个真实世界中文查询和综合多维评估标准。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中取得优异表现：BrowseComp-ZH 45.7%、BrowseComp 42.8%、WideSearch 46.5%、xbench-DS 75.0%、DeepResearch Bench 52.5分。在MindDR Bench上达到最先进的51.8分，超越了同规模开源系统，可与更大规模模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: MindDR证明了通过精心设计的智能体架构和训练流程，相对较小的模型（约30B参数）也能在深度研究任务上实现竞争性性能，并已成功部署为理想汽车在线产品，为高效AI研究系统提供了可行方案。

title: Benchmarking Classical Coverage Path Planning Heuristics on Irregular Hexagonal Grids for Maritime Coverage Scenarios
summary: Coverage path planning on irregular hexagonal grids is relevant to maritime surveillance, search and rescue and environmental monitoring, yet classical methods are often compared on small ad hoc examples or on rectangular grids. This paper presents a reproducible benchmark of deterministic single-vehicle coverage path planning heuristics on irregular hexagonal graphs derived from synthetic but maritime-motivated areas of interest. The benchmark contains 10,000 Hamiltonian-feasible instances spanning compact, elongated, and irregular morphologies, 17 heuristics from seven families, and a common evaluation protocol covering Hamiltonian success, complete-coverage success, revisits, path length, heading changes, and CPU latency. Across the released dataset, heuristics with explicit shortest-path reconnection solve the relaxed coverage task reliably but almost never produce zero-revisit tours. Exact Depth-First Search confirms that every released instance is Hamiltonian-feasible. The strongest classical Hamiltonian baseline is a Warnsdorff variant that uses an index-based tie-break together with a terminal-inclusive residual-degree policy, reaching 79.0% Hamiltonian success. The dominant design choice is not tie-breaking alone, but how the residual degree is defined when the endpoint is reserved until the final move. This shows that underreported implementation details can materially affect performance on sparse geometric graphs with bottlenecks. The benchmark is intended as a controlled testbed for heuristic analysis rather than as a claim of operational optimality at fleet scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于不规则六边形网格上确定性单车辆覆盖路径规划启发式算法的可重复基准测试，包含10,000个哈密顿可行实例和17种启发式方法，揭示了实现细节对稀疏几何图中性能的重要影响。
AI.motivation: 不规则六边形网格上的覆盖路径规划在海上监视、搜救和环境监测中具有应用价值，但现有方法通常在小型特例或矩形网格上进行比较，缺乏系统性的基准测试。
AI.method: 创建了一个包含10,000个哈密顿可行实例的基准测试集，这些实例基于合成但具有海事动机的兴趣区域，覆盖紧凑、细长和不规则形态。评估了来自7个家族的17种启发式算法，使用包含哈密顿成功、完全覆盖成功、重访次数、路径长度、航向变化和CPU延迟的通用评估协议。
AI.result: 具有显式最短路径重连的启发式算法能可靠解决松弛覆盖任务，但几乎无法产生零重访路径。最强的经典哈密顿基线是使用基于索引的平局打破和终端包含残差度策略的Warnsdorff变体，达到79.0%的哈密顿成功率。关键设计选择不是平局打破本身，而是在端点保留到最后一步时如何定义残差度。
AI.conclusion: 未充分报告的实现细节会显著影响在具有瓶颈的稀疏几何图上的性能。该基准测试旨在作为启发式算法分析的受控测试平台，而非声称在舰队规模上的操作最优性。

title: TurboTalk: Progressive Distillation for One-Step Audio-Driven Talking Avatar Generation
summary: Existing audio-driven video digital human generation models rely on multi-step denoising, resulting in substantial computational overhead that severely limits their deployment in real-world settings. While one-step distillation approaches can significantly accelerate inference, they often suffer from training instability. To address this challenge, we propose TurboTalk, a two-stage progressive distillation framework that effectively compresses a multi-step audio-driven video diffusion model into a single-step generator. We first adopt Distribution Matching Distillation to obtain a strong and stable 4-step student, and then progressively reduce the denoising steps from 4 to 1 through adversarial distillation. To ensure stable training under extreme step reduction, we introduce a progressive timestep sampling strategy and a self-compare adversarial objective that provides an intermediate adversarial reference that stabilizes progressive distillation. Our method achieve single-step generation of video talking avatar, boosting inference speed by 120 times while maintaining high generation quality.

AI.tldr: TurboTalk：一种两阶段渐进式蒸馏框架，将多步音频驱动视频扩散模型压缩为单步生成器，推理速度提升120倍
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动视频数字人生成模型依赖多步去噪，计算开销大，限制了实际部署。一步蒸馏方法能加速推理但训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出两阶段渐进蒸馏框架：1）使用分布匹配蒸馏获得稳定的4步学生模型；2）通过对抗蒸馏逐步将去噪步数从4减少到1。引入渐进时间步采样策略和自比较对抗目标来稳定训练。
AI.result: 实现了视频说话头像的单步生成，推理速度提升120倍，同时保持高质量生成效果。
AI.conclusion: TurboTalk有效解决了音频驱动视频生成模型的计算效率问题，通过渐进蒸馏实现了高质量单步生成，具有实际部署价值。

title: Quantifying Cross-Query Contradictions in Multi-Query LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. 9 pages, 6 tables, code and data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rohitspider/cross_query_benchmark
summary: Large language models frequently produce mutually inconsistent answers when reasoning over multiple related queries. We study case-file logical consistency: maintaining a globally satisfiable belief state across interdependent queries. We introduce a benchmark of 390 multi-query reasoning instances with entailment/contradiction/unknown labels and propose set-level metrics including Case Satisfiability Rate, Contradiction Density and Revision Cost. Our solver-augmented approach extracts commitments, verifies global satisfiability and performs counterexample-guided repair. Across four reasoning domains, our method substantially reduces cross-query contradictions (SetCons: 0.56 to 0.94) while preserving per-query accuracy, demonstrating that global coherence is critical for robust multi-query reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型在多查询推理中的逻辑一致性，提出案例文件一致性概念，建立包含390个实例的基准测试，开发基于求解器的方法来提取承诺、验证全局可满足性并进行反例引导修复，显著减少了跨查询矛盾。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理多个相关查询时经常产生相互矛盾的答案，这影响了推理的可靠性。研究旨在解决案例文件逻辑一致性问题，即跨相互依赖查询维持全局可满足的信念状态。
AI.method: 提出基于求解器的方法：1）从模型回答中提取逻辑承诺；2）使用求解器验证全局可满足性；3）进行反例引导的修复。建立包含390个多查询推理实例的基准测试，包含蕴含/矛盾/未知标签，并提出集合级指标如案例可满足率、矛盾密度和修订成本。
AI.result: 在四个推理领域中，该方法显著减少了跨查询矛盾（SetCons从0.56提升到0.94），同时保持了每个查询的准确性，证明全局一致性对稳健的多查询推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 全局一致性是稳健多查询推理的关键因素，提出的基于求解器的方法能有效减少大语言模型中的跨查询矛盾，同时保持单个查询的准确性，为改进多查询推理系统提供了有效途径。

title: A Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Action Tokenizer for In-Context Imitation Learning in Robotics
summary: We present a novel hierarchical spatiotemporal action tokenizer for in-context imitation learning. We first propose a hierarchical approach, which consists of two successive levels of vector quantization. In particular, the lower level assigns input actions to fine-grained subclusters, while the higher level further maps fine-grained subclusters to clusters. Our hierarchical approach outperforms the non-hierarchical counterpart, while mainly exploiting spatial information by reconstructing input actions. Furthermore, we extend our approach by utilizing both spatial and temporal cues, forming a hierarchical spatiotemporal action tokenizer, namely HiST-AT. Specifically, our hierarchical spatiotemporal approach conducts multi-level clustering, while simultaneously recovering input actions and their associated timestamps. Finally, extensive evaluations on multiple simulation and real robotic manipulation benchmarks show that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art performance in in-context imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于上下文模仿学习的层次化时空动作分词器HiST-AT，通过两级向量量化和时空信息利用，在多个机器人操作基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的动作表示方法在上下文模仿学习中存在局限性，需要更有效的动作编码方式来捕捉动作的层次结构和时空特性，以提高模仿学习的性能。
AI.method: 提出层次化时空动作分词器HiST-AT：1）采用两级向量量化，底层将输入动作分配到细粒度子簇，高层进一步将子簇映射到簇；2）扩展为时空版本，同时恢复输入动作及其关联的时间戳；3）利用空间和时空线索进行多级聚类。
AI.result: 在多个仿真和真实机器人操作基准测试中，该方法超越了非层次化方法，并建立了上下文模仿学习的最新性能水平。
AI.conclusion: HiST-AT通过层次化时空动作分词有效提升了上下文模仿学习的性能，为机器人动作表示和模仿学习提供了新的有效方法。

title: MapSR: Prompt-Driven Land Cover Map Super-Resolution via Vision Foundation Models
summary: High-resolution (HR) land-cover mapping is often constrained by the high cost of dense HR annotations. We revisit this problem from the perspective of map super-resolution, which enhances coarse low-resolution (LR) land-cover products into HR maps at the resolution of the input imagery. Existing weakly supervised methods can leverage LR labels, but they typically use them to retrain dense predictors with substantial computational cost. We propose MapSR, a prompt-driven framework that decouples supervision from model training. MapSR uses LR labels once to extract class prompts from frozen vision foundation model features through a lightweight linear probe, after which HR mapping proceeds via training-free metric inference and graph-based prediction refinement. Specifically, class prompts are estimated by aggregating high-confidence HR features identified by the linear probe, and HR predictions are obtained by cosine-similarity matching followed by graph-based propagation for spatial refinement. Experiments on the Chesapeake Bay dataset show that MapSR achieves 59.64% mIoU without any HR labels, remaining competitive with the strongest weakly supervised baseline and surpassing a fully supervised baseline. Notably, MapSR reduces trainable parameters by four orders of magnitude and shortens training time from hours to minutes, enabling scalable HR mapping under limited annotation and compute budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/rikirikirikiriki/MapSR.

AI.tldr: MapSR：一种无需高分辨率标注的提示驱动框架，通过线性探针提取类别提示，结合无训练度量推理和图传播实现高效高分辨率土地覆盖制图
AI.motivation: 高分辨率土地覆盖制图面临密集标注成本高昂的问题，现有弱监督方法虽然能利用低分辨率标签，但需要重新训练密集预测器，计算成本高。需要一种能解耦监督与模型训练的更高效方法。
AI.method: 提出MapSR框架：1）使用低分辨率标签通过轻量级线性探针从冻结视觉基础模型特征中提取类别提示；2）通过无训练度量推理（余弦相似度匹配）获得高分辨率预测；3）基于图的预测细化进行空间优化。整个过程仅需一次低分辨率标签提取提示，后续无需训练。
AI.result: 在Chesapeake Bay数据集上，MapSR在无任何高分辨率标签情况下达到59.64% mIoU，与最强弱监督基线相当，甚至超过全监督基线。参数量减少4个数量级，训练时间从小时级缩短到分钟级。
AI.conclusion: MapSR通过解耦监督与训练，实现了高效、可扩展的高分辨率土地覆盖制图，在有限标注和计算预算下具有显著优势，为遥感图像分析提供了新思路。

title: Dissecting Failure Dynamics in Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance through extended inference-time deliberation, yet how their reasoning failures arise remains poorly understood. By analyzing model-generated reasoning trajectories, we find that errors are not uniformly distributed but often originate from a small number of early transition points, after which reasoning remains locally coherent but globally incorrect. These transitions coincide with localized spikes in token-level entropy, and alternative continuations from the same intermediate state can still lead to correct solutions. Based on these observations, we introduce GUARD, a targeted inference-time framework that probes and redirects critical transitions using uncertainty signals. Empirical evaluations across multiple benchmarks confirm that interventions guided by these failure dynamics lead to more reliable reasoning outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding when and how reasoning first deviates, complementing existing approaches that focus on scaling inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: GUARD框架通过识别和重定向早期关键转换点来改善大语言模型的推理可靠性，这些转换点通常伴随着token级熵的局部峰值，是推理失败的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通过扩展推理时间思考获得强大性能，但其推理失败机制仍不明确。现有研究主要关注扩展推理计算，而忽略了理解推理何时以及如何首次偏离正确路径的重要性。
AI.method: 通过分析模型生成的推理轨迹，发现错误并非均匀分布，而是源于少数早期转换点。这些转换点与token级熵的局部峰值重合，且从相同中间状态的替代延续仍能导向正确解。基于此，提出GUARD框架，利用不确定性信号探测和重定向关键转换。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实证评估证实，基于这些失败动态指导的干预能带来更可靠的推理结果。该方法补充了现有专注于扩展推理计算的方法。
AI.conclusion: 理解推理何时以及如何首次偏离正确路径对于改善大语言模型的推理可靠性至关重要。GUARD框架通过识别和干预早期关键转换点，为提升模型推理性能提供了新途径。

title: Vision-Based Safe Human-Robot Collaboration with Uncertainty Guarantees
summary: We propose a framework for vision-based human pose estimation and motion prediction that gives conformal prediction guarantees for certifiably safe human-robot collaboration. Our framework combines aleatoric uncertainty estimation with OOD detection for high probabilistic confidence. To integrate our pipeline in certifiable safety frameworks, we propose conformal prediction sets for human motion predictions with high, valid confidence. We evaluate our pipeline on recorded human motion data and a real-world human-robot collaboration setting.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于视觉人体姿态估计和运动预测的框架，为可认证安全的人机协作提供保形预测保证
AI.motivation: 为可认证安全的人机协作开发具有概率置信度保证的视觉人体姿态估计和运动预测框架
AI.method: 结合偶然不确定性估计与离群检测，提出用于人体运动预测的保形预测集，集成到可认证安全框架中
AI.result: 在记录的人体运动数据和真实人机协作场景中评估了该框架
AI.conclusion: 该框架为可认证安全的人机协作提供了具有高有效置信度的保形预测保证

title: Prompt-Guided Image Editing with Masked Logit Nudging in Visual Autoregressive Models
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Findings (CVPRF)
summary: We address the problem of prompt-guided image editing in visual autoregressive models. Given a source image and a target text prompt, we aim to modify the source image according to the target prompt, while preserving all regions which are unrelated to the requested edit. To this end, we present Masked Logit Nudging, which uses the source image token maps to introduce a guidance step that aligns the model's predictions under the target prompt with these source token maps. Specifically, we convert the fixed source encodings into logits using the VAR encoding, nudging the model's predicted logits towards the targets along a semantic trajectory defined by the source-target prompts. Edits are applied only within spatial masks obtained through a dedicated masking scheme that leverages cross-attention differences between the source and edited prompts. Then, we introduce a refinement to correct quantization errors and improve reconstruction quality. Our approach achieves the best image editing performance on the PIE benchmark at 512px and 1024px resolutions. Beyond editing, our method delivers faithful reconstructions and outperforms previous methods on COCO at 512px and OpenImages at 1024px. Overall, our method outperforms VAR-related approaches and achieves comparable or even better performance than diffusion models, while being much faster. Code is available at 'https://github.com/AmirMaEl/MLN'.

AI.tldr: 提出Masked Logit Nudging方法，用于视觉自回归模型中的提示引导图像编辑，通过源图像token映射引导模型预测，在保留无关区域的同时实现目标提示编辑
AI.motivation: 解决视觉自回归模型中提示引导图像编辑的问题，需要在根据目标提示修改源图像的同时，保留与编辑请求无关的所有区域
AI.method: 提出Masked Logit Nudging方法：1) 使用源图像token映射引入引导步骤，使模型在目标提示下的预测与源token映射对齐；2) 将固定源编码通过VAR编码转换为logits，沿源-目标提示定义的语义轨迹推动模型预测logits；3) 通过利用源和编辑提示间交叉注意力差异的专用掩码方案，仅在空间掩码内应用编辑；4) 引入细化步骤纠正量化误差并提高重建质量
AI.result: 在512px和1024px分辨率的PIE基准测试中实现最佳图像编辑性能；在COCO（512px）和OpenImages（1024px）上超越先前方法，提供忠实重建；整体性能优于VAR相关方法，与扩散模型相当甚至更好，且速度更快
AI.conclusion: Masked Logit Nudging方法在视觉自回归模型中实现了高效的提示引导图像编辑，在保持无关区域的同时完成目标提示修改，在多个基准测试中表现优异，速度优势明显

title: Abstract Sim2Real through Approximate Information States
summary: In recent years, reinforcement learning (RL) has shown remarkable success in robotics when a fast and accurate simulator is available for a given task. When using RL and simulation, more simulator realism is generally beneficial but becomes harder to obtain as robots are deployed in increasingly complex and widescale domains. In such settings, simulators will likely fail to model all relevant details of a given target task and this observation motivates the study of sim2real with simulators that leave out key task details. In this paper, we formalize and study the abstract sim2real problem: given an abstract simulator that models a target task at a coarse level of abstraction, how can we train a policy with RL in the abstract simulator and successfully transfer it to the real-world? Our first contribution is to formalize this problem using the language of state abstraction from the RL literature. This framing shows that an abstract simulator can be grounded to match the target task if the grounded abstract dynamics take the history of states into account. Based on the formalism, we then introduce a method that uses real-world task data to correct the dynamics of the abstract simulator. We then show that this method enables successful policy transfer both in sim2sim and sim2real evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究抽象模拟器到真实世界的强化学习迁移问题，提出通过历史状态信息来修正抽象模拟器动力学的方法
AI.motivation: 随着机器人在复杂和大规模领域部署，模拟器难以建模所有任务细节，需要研究在抽象模拟器（忽略关键细节）中训练策略并成功迁移到真实世界的问题
AI.method: 使用强化学习中的状态抽象理论形式化抽象sim2real问题，提出基于真实世界任务数据修正抽象模拟器动力学的方法，通过考虑历史状态信息来接地抽象模拟器
AI.result: 该方法在sim2sim和sim2real评估中都能实现成功的策略迁移
AI.conclusion: 抽象模拟器可以通过考虑历史状态信息来接地以匹配目标任务，基于真实数据修正抽象模拟器动力学是实现成功策略迁移的有效方法

title: Towards Design Compositing
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Workshop on CVEU
summary: Graphic design creation involves harmoniously assembling multimodal components such as images, text, logos, and other visual assets collected from diverse sources, into a visually-appealing and cohesive design. Recent methods have largely focused on layout prediction or complementary element generation, while retaining input elements exactly, implicitly assuming that provided components are already stylistically harmonious. In practice, inputs often come from disparate sources and exhibit visual mismatch, making this assumption limiting. We argue that identity-preserving stylization and compositing of input elements is a critical missing ingredient for truly harmonized components-to-design pipelines. To this end, we propose GIST, a training-free, identity-preserving image compositor that sits between layout prediction and typography generation, and can be plugged into any existing components-to-design or design-refining pipeline without modification. We demonstrate this by integrating GIST with two substantially different existing methods, LaDeCo and Design-o-meter. GIST shows significant improvements in visual harmony and aesthetic quality across both pipelines, as validated by LLaVA-OV and GPT-4V on aspect-wise ratings and pairwise preference over naive pasting. Project Page: abhinav-mahajan10.github.io/GIST/.

AI.tldr: GIST是一个无需训练、保持身份的图像合成器，可插入现有组件到设计流程中，通过风格化解决视觉不匹配问题，显著提升视觉和谐度与美学质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设输入组件已风格和谐，但实践中组件常来自不同来源存在视觉不匹配，需要身份保持的风格化与合成作为关键缺失环节。
AI.method: 提出GIST作为无需训练、保持身份的图像合成器，位于布局预测与排版生成之间，可无缝集成到任何现有组件到设计或设计优化流程中。
AI.result: 将GIST集成到LaDeCo和Design-o-meter两种不同方法中，通过LLaVA-OV和GPT-4V评估显示，相比简单粘贴在视觉和谐度与美学质量上有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: GIST填补了组件到设计流程中身份保持风格化与合成的关键空白，可灵活集成到现有方法中，有效解决视觉不匹配问题，提升设计和谐度。

title: MARS$^2$: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms have demonstrated strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks such as code generation. However, limited trajectory diversity often leads to diminishing returns, which constrains the achievable performance ceiling. Search-enhanced RL alleviates this issue by introducing structured exploration, which remains constrained by the single-agent policy priors. Meanwhile, leveraging multiple interacting policies can acquire more diverse exploratory signals, but existing approaches are typically decoupled from structured search. We propose \textbf{MARS$^2$} (Multi-Agent Reinforced Tree-Search Scaling), a unified RL framework in which multiple independently-optimized agents collaborate within a shared tree-structured search environment. MARS$^2$ models the search tree as a learnable multi-agent interaction environment, enabling heterogeneous agents to collaboratively generate and refine candidate solutions within a shared search topology. To support effective learning, we introduce a path-level group advantage formulation based on tree-consistent reward shaping, which facilitates effective credit assignment across complex search trajectories. Experiments on code generation benchmarks show that MARS$^2$ consistently improves performance across diverse model combinations and training settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of coupling multi-agent collaboration with tree search for enhancing reinforcement learning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI.

AI.tldr: MARS²是一个统一的多智能体强化学习框架，通过让多个独立优化的智能体在共享的树状搜索环境中协作，解决传统强化学习在代码生成等推理密集型任务中轨迹多样性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习在推理密集型任务（如代码生成）中面临轨迹多样性有限导致收益递减的问题。现有的搜索增强RL方法虽然引入了结构化探索，但仍受限于单智能体策略先验；而多智能体方法能获得更多样化的探索信号，但通常与结构化搜索解耦。
AI.method: MARS²将搜索树建模为可学习的多智能体交互环境，让异构智能体在共享搜索拓扑中协作生成和优化候选解。引入基于树一致奖励塑形的路径级群体优势公式，支持复杂搜索轨迹的有效信用分配。
AI.result: 在代码生成基准测试中，MARS²在不同模型组合和训练设置下均能持续提升性能，证明了将多智能体协作与树搜索耦合对增强强化学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MARS²通过统一的多智能体强化学习框架，成功地将多智能体协作与树搜索相结合，有效解决了强化学习中的轨迹多样性限制问题，在代码生成任务上展现出优越性能。

title: Efficient closed-form approaches for pose estimation using Sylvester forms
summary: Solving non-linear least-squares problem for pose estimation (rotation and translation) is often a time consuming yet fundamental problem in several real-time computer vision applications. With an adequate rotation parametrization, the optimization problem can be reduced to the solution of a~system of polynomial equations and solved in closed form. Recent advances in efficient closed form solvers utilizing resultant matrices have shown a promising research direction to decrease the computation time while preserving the estimation accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new class of resultant-based solvers that exploit Sylvester forms to further reduce the complexity of the resolution. We demonstrate that our proposed methods are numerically as accurate as the state-of-the-art solvers, and outperform them in terms of computational time. We show that this approach can be applied for pose estimation in two different types of problems: estimating a pose from 3D to 3D correspondences, and estimating a pose from 3D points to 2D points correspondences.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Sylvester形式的结式求解器，用于位姿估计的非线性最小二乘问题，在保持精度的同时显著降低计算时间
AI.motivation: 位姿估计中的非线性最小二乘问题在实时计算机视觉应用中耗时严重，需要更高效的闭式求解方法
AI.method: 利用Sylvester形式开发新型结式求解器，降低求解复杂度，适用于3D-3D和3D-2D对应关系的位姿估计
AI.result: 新方法在数值精度上与最先进求解器相当，但在计算时间上显著优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: Sylvester形式的结式求解器为位姿估计提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案，适用于多种对应关系类型

title: Multigrain-aware Semantic Prototype Scanning and Tri-Token Prompt Learning Embraced High-Order RWKV for Pan-Sharpening
summary: In this work, we propose a Multigrain-aware Semantic Prototype Scanning paradigm for pan-sharpening, built upon a high-order RWKV architecture and a tri-token prompting mechanism derived from semantic clustering. Specifically, our method contains three key components: 1) Multigrain-aware Semantic Prototype Scanning. Although RWKV offers a efficient linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, its conventional bidirectional raster scanning is still semantic-agnostic and prone to positional bias. To address this issue, we introduce a semantic-driven scanning strategy that leverages locality-sensitive hashing to group semantically related regions and construct multi-grain semantic prototypes, enabling context-aware token reordering and more coherent global interaction. 2) Tri-token Prompt Learning. We design a tri-token prompting mechanism consisting of a global token, cluster-derived prototype tokens, and a learnable register token. The global and prototype tokens provide complementary semantic priors for RWKV modeling, while the register token helps suppress noisy and artifact-prone intermediate representations. 3) Invertible Q-Shift. To counteract spatial details, we apply center difference convolution on the value pathway to inject high-frequency information, and introduce an invertible multi-scale Q-shift operation for efficient and lossless feature transformation without parameter-heavy receptive field expansion. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高阶RWKV架构和语义聚类三令牌提示机制的多粒度感知语义原型扫描范式用于全色锐化
AI.motivation: 传统RWKV的双向光栅扫描缺乏语义感知且易受位置偏差影响，需要更有效的上下文建模机制来提升全色锐化性能
AI.method: 包含三个核心组件：1) 多粒度感知语义原型扫描，利用局部敏感哈希进行语义分组和原型构建；2) 三令牌提示学习机制，包含全局令牌、聚类原型令牌和可学习寄存器令牌；3) 可逆Q-Shift操作，通过中心差分卷积注入高频信息
AI.result: 实验结果表明该方法在性能上具有优越性
AI.conclusion: 提出的多粒度感知语义原型扫描范式通过语义驱动的扫描策略、三令牌提示机制和可逆Q-Shift操作，有效提升了全色锐化的性能

title: Enhancing Mental Health Counseling Support in Bangladesh using Culturally-Grounded Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in generating supportive responses for mental health and counseling applications. However, their responses often lack cultural sensitivity, contextual grounding, and clinically appropriate guidance. This work addresses the gap of how to systematically incorporate domain-specific, clinically validated knowledge into LLMs to improve counseling quality. We utilize and compare two approaches, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a knowledge graph (KG)-based method, designed to support para-counselors. Our KG is constructed manually and clinically validated, capturing causal relationships between stressors, interventions, and outcomes, with contributions from multidisciplinary people. We evaluated multiple LLMs in both settings using BERTScore F1 and SBERT cosine similarity, as well as human evaluation across five metrics, which is designed to directly measure the effectiveness of counseling beyond similarity at the surface level. The results show that KG-based approaches consistently improve contextual relevance, clinical appropriateness, and practical usability compared to RAG alone, demonstrating that structured, expert-validated knowledge plays a critical role in addressing LLMs limitations in counseling tasks.

AI.tldr: KG方法比RAG在心理咨询任务中表现更好，能提升文化敏感性、临床适当性和实用性
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在心理健康咨询应用中缺乏文化敏感性、情境基础和临床适当指导，需要系统性地融入领域特定的临床验证知识来提升咨询质量
AI.method: 比较两种方法：检索增强生成(RAG)和基于知识图谱(KG)的方法。KG是手动构建并经过临床验证的，捕捉压力源、干预措施和结果之间的因果关系，由多学科团队贡献
AI.result: KG方法在BERTScore F1和SBERT余弦相似度评估中表现一致优于RAG，在人类评估的五个指标上（包括情境相关性、临床适当性、实用性等）也显著提升
AI.conclusion: 结构化、专家验证的知识在解决大语言模型在心理咨询任务中的局限性方面起着关键作用，KG方法能有效提升咨询响应的质量和实用性

title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints
summary: Intelligent embodied agents should not simply follow instructions, as real-world environments often involve unexpected conditions and exceptions. However, existing methods usually focus on directly executing instructions, without considering whether the target objects can actually be manipulated, meaning they fail to assess available affordances. To address this limitation, we introduce DynAfford, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction. DynAfford requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly. To enable this capability, we introduce ADAPT, a plug-and-play module that augments existing planners with explicit affordance reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ADAPT significantly improves robustness and task success across both seen and unseen environments. We also show that a domain-adapted, LoRA-finetuned vision-language model used as the affordance inference backend outperforms a commercial LLM (GPT-4o), highlighting the importance of task-aligned affordance grounding.

AI.tldr: DynAfford是一个评估具身智能体在动态环境中感知物体可供性变化的基准，ADAPT是一个可插拔模块，通过显式可供性推理增强现有规划器，显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体方法通常直接执行指令，不考虑目标物体是否可操纵，缺乏对物体可供性的评估能力。现实环境经常出现意外情况和例外，物体可供性会随时间变化且不在指令中明确说明。
AI.method: 提出DynAfford基准，评估智能体在动态环境中感知物体状态变化、推断隐式前提条件并相应调整行动的能力。开发ADAPT可插拔模块，为现有规划器增加显式可供性推理功能。使用领域适应的LoRA微调视觉语言模型作为可供性推理后端。
AI.result: 实验表明，集成ADAPT显著提高了智能体在已见和未见环境中的鲁棒性和任务成功率。领域适应的LoRA微调视觉语言模型作为可供性推理后端优于商业LLM（GPT-4o），凸显了任务对齐的可供性基础的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 显式可供性推理对于具身智能体在动态环境中成功执行任务至关重要。ADAPT模块有效增强了现有规划器的能力，领域特定的可供性基础模型优于通用大语言模型，为具身智能研究提供了新的基准和方法。

title: Switch-KD: Visual-Switch Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in joint vision-language understanding, but their large scale poses significant challenges for deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a viable way to improve model capabilities without increasing model size or data requirements, making deployment more efficient. However, applying KD to VLMs is challenged by modality-specific supervision: although multimodal knowledge in VLMs is fused within the language space, current methods supervise each modality separately without explicitly addressing multimodal alignment, leading to inconsistent multimodal knowledge transfer. To address this, we propose Switch-KD, a visual-switch distillation framework that unifies vision-language knowledge transfer within a shared text-probability space. Switch-KD comprises two key components: (1) Visual-Switch Distillation, which switches the student's visual outputs into the teacher's language pathway to construct cross-modal probabilistic references for implicit visual knowledge transfer; and (2) Dynamic Bi-directional Logits Difference (DBiLD) loss, which adaptively aligns informative probability regions while preserving the distributional structures of teacher and student through bidirectional supervision. Guided by Switch-KD, a 0.5B TinyLLaVA effectively distills rich multimodal knowledge from its 3B teacher, yielding an average improvement of 3.6 points across 10 multimodal benchmarks without any architectural modification.

AI.tldr: Switch-KD：一种视觉切换蒸馏框架，通过将学生视觉输出切换到教师语言通路，在共享文本概率空间中统一视觉-语言知识转移，解决了VLM知识蒸馏中的模态对齐问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在资源受限场景部署面临挑战，知识蒸馏(KD)可提升模型能力而不增加规模，但现有方法对多模态分别监督，缺乏显式的多模态对齐，导致知识转移不一致。
AI.method: 提出Switch-KD框架：1) 视觉切换蒸馏：将学生视觉输出切换到教师语言通路，构建跨模态概率参考实现隐式视觉知识转移；2) 动态双向对数差异损失(DBiLD)：自适应对齐信息概率区域，同时通过双向监督保持师生分布结构。
AI.result: 0.5B参数的TinyLLaVA从3B教师模型有效蒸馏丰富多模态知识，在10个多模态基准上平均提升3.6分，无需架构修改。
AI.conclusion: Switch-KD通过统一视觉-语言知识转移于共享文本概率空间，解决了VLM知识蒸馏中的模态对齐挑战，为资源受限场景下的高效VLM部署提供了有效方案。

title: Prompt Optimization Is a Coin Flip: Diagnosing When It Helps in Compound AI Systems
summary: Prompt optimization in compound AI systems is statistically indistinguishable from a coin flip: across 72 optimization runs on Claude Haiku (6 methods $\times$ 4 tasks $\times$ 3 repeats), 49% score below zero-shot; on Amazon Nova Lite, the failure rate is even higher. Yet on one task, all six methods improve over zero-shot by up to $+6.8$ points. What distinguishes success from failure? We investigate with 18,000 grid evaluations and 144 optimization runs, testing two assumptions behind end-to-end optimization tools like TextGrad and DSPy: (A) individual prompts are worth optimizing, and (B) agent prompts interact, requiring joint optimization. Interaction effects are never significant ($p > 0.52$, all $F < 1.0$), and optimization helps only when the task has exploitable output structure -- a format the model can produce but does not default to. We provide a two-stage diagnostic: an \$80 ANOVA pre-test for agent coupling, and a 10-minute headroom test that predicts whether optimization is worthwhile -- turning a coin flip into an informed decision.

AI.tldr: 提示优化在复合AI系统中的效果不稳定，成功率接近抛硬币，但特定任务下可显著提升性能。研究发现优化仅对具有可开发输出结构的任务有效，并提出了两阶段诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 当前复合AI系统中的提示优化工具（如TextGrad和DSPy）基于两个假设：(A) 单个提示值得优化，(B) 智能体提示会相互作用需要联合优化。但实际优化效果不稳定，需要探究成功与失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 通过大规模实验分析：18,000个网格评估和144次优化运行，测试了6种优化方法在4个任务上的表现（每个任务重复3次）。使用统计方法（ANOVA）分析交互效应，并开发了两阶段诊断方法：80美元的ANOVA预测试和10分钟的上限测试。
AI.result: 1. 提示优化成功率接近随机：Claude Haiku上49%的优化运行低于零样本性能，Amazon Nova Lite失败率更高。2. 交互效应不显著：所有p值>0.52，F值<1.0。3. 优化仅在任务具有可开发输出结构时有效（模型能产生但不默认的格式）。4. 在特定任务上，所有六种方法都能提升性能（最高+6.8分）。
AI.conclusion: 复合AI系统中的提示优化效果高度依赖于任务特性，而非智能体间的交互作用。提出的两阶段诊断方法（ANOVA预测试和上限测试）可将优化决策从"抛硬币"转变为基于证据的明智选择，预测优化是否值得投入。

title: R3D: Revisiting 3D Policy Learning
summary: 3D policy learning promises superior generalization and cross-embodiment transfer, but progress has been hindered by training instabilities and severe overfitting, precluding the adoption of powerful 3D perception models. In this work, we systematically diagnose these failures, identifying the omission of 3D data augmentation and the adverse effects of Batch Normalization as primary causes. We propose a new architecture coupling a scalable transformer-based 3D encoder with a diffusion decoder, engineered specifically for stability at scale and designed to leverage large-scale pre-training. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D baselines on challenging manipulation benchmarks, establishing a new and robust foundation for scalable 3D imitation learning. Project Page: https://r3d-policy.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出R3D-Policy：通过解决3D策略学习中的训练不稳定和过拟合问题，结合可扩展的Transformer 3D编码器和扩散解码器，实现稳定的大规模3D模仿学习
AI.motivation: 3D策略学习在泛化和跨具身迁移方面具有优势，但训练不稳定和严重过拟合阻碍了采用强大的3D感知模型，需要系统诊断和解决这些问题
AI.method: 系统诊断失败原因，识别出缺乏3D数据增强和Batch Normalization的负面影响；提出新架构：将可扩展的Transformer 3D编码器与扩散解码器耦合，专门为大规模稳定性设计，能够利用大规模预训练
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的操作基准测试中显著优于最先进的3D基线方法，为可扩展的3D模仿学习建立了新的稳健基础
AI.conclusion: 通过解决训练不稳定和过拟合问题，结合适当的架构设计，成功实现了稳定且可扩展的3D策略学习，为3D模仿学习提供了新的强大基础

title: CMTM: Cross-Modal Token Modulation for Unsupervised Video Object Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2025
summary: Recent advances in unsupervised video object segmentation have highlighted the potential of two-stream architectures that integrate appearance and motion cues. However, fully leveraging these complementary sources of information requires effectively modeling their interdependencies. In this paper, we introduce cross-modality token modulation, a novel approach designed to strengthen the interaction between appearance and motion cues. Our method establishes dense connections between tokens from each modality, enabling efficient intra-modal and inter-modal information propagation through relation transformer blocks. To improve learning efficiency, we incorporate a token masking strategy that addresses the limitations of relying solely on increased model complexity. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across all public benchmarks, outperforming existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态令牌调制方法，通过关系Transformer块建立外观与运动模态间的密集连接，结合令牌掩码策略提升学习效率，在无监督视频对象分割任务中实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前无监督视频对象分割的双流架构虽然整合了外观和运动线索，但未能充分建模这两种互补信息源之间的相互依赖关系，限制了性能提升。
AI.method: 提出跨模态令牌调制方法：1) 建立外观和运动模态令牌间的密集连接；2) 通过关系Transformer块实现高效的模态内和模态间信息传播；3) 引入令牌掩码策略以解决仅依赖增加模型复杂度的局限性。
AI.result: 该方法在所有公开基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，超越了现有所有方法。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态令牌调制通过有效建模外观与运动线索的相互依赖关系，结合令牌掩码策略提升学习效率，显著改善了无监督视频对象分割的性能。

title: GDPR Auto-Formalization with AI Agents and Human Verification
summary: We study the overall process of automatic formalization of GDPR provisions using large language models, within a human-in-the-loop verification framework. Rather than aiming for full autonomy, we adopt a role-specialized workflow in which LLM-based AI components, operating in a multi-agent setting with iterative feedback, generate legal scenarios, formal rules, and atomic facts. This is coupled with independent verification modules which include human reviewers' assessment of representational, logical, and legal correctness. Using this approach, we construct a high-quality dataset to be used for GDPR auto-formalization, and analyze both successful and problematic cases. Our results show that structured verification and targeted human oversight are essential for reliable legal formalization, especially in the presence of legal nuance and context-sensitive reasoning.

AI.tldr: 使用大型语言模型在人类参与验证框架下自动形式化GDPR条款的研究，采用角色专业化工作流程，结合独立验证模块构建高质量数据集
AI.motivation: 研究如何利用大型语言模型自动形式化GDPR条款，但认识到完全自主的局限性，因此采用人类参与验证的框架来确保法律形式化的可靠性和准确性
AI.method: 采用角色专业化工作流程，在多智能体设置中使用LLM生成法律场景、形式规则和原子事实，结合独立验证模块（包括人类评审员对表示、逻辑和法律正确性的评估）和迭代反馈机制
AI.result: 构建了用于GDPR自动形式化的高质量数据集，分析了成功和问题案例，结果表明结构化验证和针对性人类监督对于可靠的法律形式化至关重要，特别是在存在法律细微差别和上下文敏感推理的情况下
AI.conclusion: 结构化验证和人类监督是法律自动形式化的关键要素，特别是在处理法律细微差别和上下文敏感推理时，多智能体LLM框架结合人类验证能够产生高质量的法律形式化结果

title: High-Speed Full-Color HDR Imaging via Unwrapping Modulo-Encoded Spike Streams
summary: Conventional RGB-based high dynamic range (HDR) imaging faces a fundamental trade-off between motion artifacts in multi-exposure captures and irreversible information loss in single-shot techniques. Modulo sensors offer a promising alternative by encoding theoretically unbounded dynamic range into wrapped measurements. However, existing modulo solutions remain bottlenecked by iterative unwrapping overhead and hardware constraints limiting them to low-speed, grayscale capture. In this work, we present a complete modulo-based HDR imaging system that enables high-speed, full-color HDR acquisition by synergistically advancing both the sensing formulation and the unwrapping algorithm. At the core of our approach is an exposure-decoupled formulation of modulo imaging that allows multiple measurements to be interleaved in time, preserving a clean, observation-wise measurement model. Building upon this, we introduce an iteration-free unwrapping algorithm that integrates diffusion-based generative priors with the physical least absolute remainder property of modulo images, supporting highly efficient, physics-consistent HDR reconstruction. Finally, to validate the practical viability of our system, we demonstrate a proof-of-concept hardware implementation based on modulo-encoded spike streams. This setup preserves the native high temporal resolution of spike cameras, achieving 1000 FPS full-color imaging while reducing output data bandwidth from approximately 20 Gbps to 6 Gbps. Extensive evaluations indicate that our coordinated approach successfully overcomes key systemic bottlenecks, demonstrating the feasibility of deploying modulo imaging in dynamic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于模数传感器的高速全彩色HDR成像系统，通过曝光解耦的模数成像公式和基于扩散先验的无迭代解包算法，实现1000FPS全彩色HDR成像，同时将数据带宽从20Gbps降至6Gbps。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB HDR成像面临多曝光运动伪影与单次拍摄信息丢失的根本权衡。现有模数传感器解决方案受限于迭代解包开销和硬件约束，只能实现低速灰度捕获。
AI.method: 1) 提出曝光解耦的模数成像公式，允许时间交错的多重测量；2) 开发基于扩散生成先验与模数图像最小绝对余数物理特性的无迭代解包算法；3) 基于模数编码脉冲流实现硬件原型，保留脉冲相机的高时间分辨率。
AI.result: 实现1000FPS全彩色HDR成像，输出数据带宽从约20Gbps降低至6Gbps。系统克服了关键系统性瓶颈，验证了模数成像在动态场景中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同推进传感公式和解包算法，构建了完整的模数HDR成像系统，成功解决了传统HDR成像的权衡问题，为动态场景中的高速全彩色HDR成像提供了可行方案。

title: El Agente Forjador: Task-Driven Agent Generation for Quantum Simulation
summary: AI for science promises to accelerate the discovery process. The advent of large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows enables the expediting of a growing range of scientific tasks. However, most of the current generation of agentic systems depend on static, hand-curated toolsets that hinder adaptation to new domains and evolving libraries. We present El Agente Forjador, a multi-agent framework in which universal coding agents autonomously forge, validate, and reuse computational tools through a four-stage workflow of tool analysis, tool generation, task execution, and iterative solution evaluation. Evaluated across 24 tasks spanning quantum chemistry and quantum dynamics on five coding agent setups, we compare three operating modes: zero-shot generation of tools per task, reuse of a curriculum-built toolset, and direct problem-solving with the coding agents as the baseline. We find that our tool generation and reuse framework consistently improves accuracy over the baseline. We also show that reusing a toolset built by a stronger coding agent can reduce API cost and substantially raises the solution quality for weaker coding agents. Case studies further demonstrate that tools forged for different domains can be combined to solve hybrid tasks. Taken together, these results show that LLM-based agents can use their scientific knowledge and coding capabilities to autonomously build reusable scientific tools, pointing toward a paradigm in which agent capabilities are defined by the tasks they are designed to solve rather than by explicitly engineered implementations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出El Agente Forjador多智能体框架，通过自主锻造、验证和重用计算工具来加速科学发现，相比静态工具集显著提升任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的智能体系统大多依赖静态、手动策划的工具集，这阻碍了其适应新领域和演化库的能力。需要一种能够自主构建和重用计算工具的方法来加速科学发现过程。
AI.method: 提出El Agente Forjador多智能体框架，采用四阶段工作流：工具分析、工具生成、任务执行和迭代解决方案评估。通用编码智能体通过该流程自主锻造、验证和重用计算工具。评估了三种操作模式：零次生成（每个任务生成新工具）、重用课程构建的工具集、以及直接问题解决（基线）。
AI.result: 在量子化学和量子动力学领域的24个任务上评估了5种编码智能体设置。结果显示：1）工具生成和重用框架相比基线持续提高准确率；2）重用由更强编码智能体构建的工具集可以降低API成本，并显著提升较弱智能体的解决方案质量；3）案例研究表明，为不同领域锻造的工具可以组合解决混合任务。
AI.conclusion: 基于大语言模型的智能体能够利用其科学知识和编码能力自主构建可重用的科学工具。这指向一种新范式：智能体能力由其设计解决的任务定义，而非通过显式工程实现。该框架为科学发现提供了更灵活、自适应的工具构建方法。

title: Physically-Induced Atmospheric Adversarial Perturbations: Enhancing Transferability and Robustness in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Adversarial attacks pose a severe threat to the reliability of deep learning models in remote sensing (RS) image classification. Most existing methods rely on direct pixel-wise perturbations, failing to exploit the inherent atmospheric characteristics of RS imagery or survive real-world image degradations. In this paper, we propose FogFool, a physically plausible adversarial framework that generates fog-based perturbations by iteratively optimizing atmospheric patterns based on Perlin noise. By modeling fog formations with natural, irregular structures, FogFool generates adversarial examples that are not only visually consistent with authentic RS scenes but also deceptive. By leveraging the spatial coherence and mid-to-low-frequency nature of atmospheric phenomena, FogFool embeds adversarial information into structural features shared across diverse architectures. Extensive experiments on two benchmark RS datasets demonstrate that FogFool achieves superior performance: not only does it exceed in white-box settings, but also exhibits exceptional black-box transferability (reaching 83.74% TASR) and robustness against common preprocessing-based defenses such as JPEG compression and filtering. Detailed analyses, including confusion matrices and Class Activation Map (CAM) visualizations, reveal that our atmospheric-driven perturbations induce a universal shift in model attention. These results indicate that FogFool represents a practical, stealthy, and highly persistent threat to RS classification systems, providing a robust benchmark for evaluating model reliability in complex environments.

AI.tldr: FogFool：一种基于物理可信雾扰动的遥感图像对抗攻击框架，通过Perlin噪声优化大气模式生成对抗样本，具有高隐蔽性、强迁移性和抗防御能力。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击方法主要依赖像素级扰动，未能充分利用遥感图像固有的大气特性，且难以在真实世界图像退化中保持有效性。遥感图像分类系统面临严重对抗威胁，需要更物理可信的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出FogFool框架，基于Perlin噪声迭代优化大气模式生成雾状扰动。利用大气现象的空间相干性和中低频特性，将对抗信息嵌入到不同架构共享的结构特征中，生成视觉一致且具有欺骗性的对抗样本。
AI.result: 在两个基准遥感数据集上的实验表明：FogFool在白盒设置中表现优异，在黑盒迁移性方面达到83.74% TASR，对JPEG压缩和滤波等预处理防御具有强鲁棒性。CAM可视化显示大气驱动扰动能引起模型注意力的普遍偏移。
AI.conclusion: FogFool代表了对遥感分类系统实用、隐蔽且高度持久的威胁，为评估复杂环境下模型可靠性提供了稳健的基准。大气特征驱动的对抗攻击比传统像素级攻击更具实际威胁性。

title: CoDaS: AI Co-Data-Scientist for Biomarker Discovery via Wearable Sensors
summary: Scientific discovery in digital health requires converting continuous physiological signals from wearable devices into clinically actionable biomarkers. We introduce CoDaS (AI Co-Data-Scientist), a multi-agent system that structures biomarker discovery as an iterative process combining hypothesis generation, statistical analysis, adversarial validation, and literature-grounded reasoning with human oversight using large-scale wearable datasets. Across three cohorts totaling 9,279 participant-observations, CoDaS identified 41 candidate digital biomarkers for mental health and 25 for metabolic outcomes, each subjected to an internal validation battery spanning replication, stability, robustness, and discriminative power. Across two independent depression cohorts, CoDaS surfaced circadian instability-related features in both datasets, reflected in sleep duration variability (DWB, ρ= 0.252, p < 0.001) and sleep onset variability (GLOBEM, ρ= 0.126, p < 0.001). In a metabolic cohort, CoDaS derived a cardiovascular fitness index (steps/resting heart rate; ρ= -0.374, p < 0.001), and recovered established clinical associations, including the hepatic function ratio (AST/ALT; ρ= -0.375, p < 0.001), a known correlate of insulin resistance. Incorporating CoDaS-derived features alongside demographic variables led to modest but consistent improvements in predictive performance, with cross-validated ΔR^2 increases of 0.040 for depression and 0.021 for insulin resistance. These findings suggest that CoDaS enables systematic and traceable hypothesis generation and prioritization for biomarker discovery from large-scale wearable data.

AI.tldr: CoDaS是一个多智能体系统，通过结合假设生成、统计分析、对抗验证和文献推理，从大规模可穿戴设备数据中系统发现数字生物标志物，应用于心理健康和代谢健康领域。
AI.motivation: 数字健康领域需要将可穿戴设备的连续生理信号转化为临床可操作的生物标志物，但传统方法缺乏系统性、可追溯的假设生成和验证流程。
AI.method: CoDaS采用多智能体系统架构，将生物标志物发现构建为迭代过程，包括假设生成、统计分析、对抗验证、文献推理和人工监督，应用于三个队列共9,279个参与者观测数据。
AI.result: 在心理健康领域识别了41个候选数字生物标志物，在代谢健康领域识别了25个；发现了昼夜节律不稳定性特征与抑郁的关联，以及心血管健康指数、肝功能比等已知临床关联；加入CoDaS衍生特征后预测性能有适度提升。
AI.conclusion: CoDaS能够从大规模可穿戴数据中实现系统性、可追溯的假设生成和优先级排序，为数字生物标志物发现提供了有效框架。

title: Chaotic CNN for Limited Data Image Classification
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) often exhibit poor generalisation in limited training data scenarios due to overfitting and insufficient feature diversity. In this work, a simple and effective chaos-based feature transformation is proposed to enhance CNN performance without increasing model complexity. The method applies nonlinear transformations using logistic, skew tent, and sine maps to normalised feature vectors before the classification layer, thereby reshaping the feature space and improving class separability. The approach is evaluated on greyscale datasets (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and an RGB dataset (CIFAR-10) using CNN architectures of varying depth under limited data conditions. The results show consistent improvement over the standalone (SA) CNN across all datasets. Notably, a maximum performance gain of 5.43% is achieved on MNIST using the skew tent map with a 3-layer CNN at 40 samples per class. A higher gain of 9.11% is observed on Fashion-MNIST using the sine map with a 3-layer CNN at 50 samples per class. Additionally, a strong gain of 7.47% is obtained on CIFAR-10 using the skew tent map at 200 samples per class. The consistent improvements across different chaotic maps indicate that the performance gain is driven by the shared nonlinear and dynamical properties of chaotic systems. The proposed method is computationally efficient, requires no additional trainable parameters, and can be easily integrated into existing CNN architectures, making it a practical solution for data-scarce image classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于混沌的特征变换方法，在有限训练数据场景下提升CNN性能，无需增加模型复杂度
AI.motivation: CNN在有限训练数据场景下常因过拟合和特征多样性不足而泛化能力差，需要一种简单有效的方法来增强特征表示
AI.method: 在分类层前对归一化特征向量应用混沌非线性变换（逻辑映射、斜帐篷映射、正弦映射），重塑特征空间并改善类别可分性
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上均取得显著性能提升：MNIST最大提升5.43%，Fashion-MNIST提升9.11%，CIFAR-10提升7.47%
AI.conclusion: 该方法计算高效、无需额外可训练参数、易于集成到现有CNN架构中，是数据稀缺图像分类任务的实用解决方案

title: A Parallel Approach to Counting Exact Covers Based on Decomposability Property
summary: The exact cover problem is a classical NP-hard problem with broad applications in the area of AI. Algorithm DXZ is a method to count exact covers representing by zero-suppressed binary decision diagrams (ZBDDs). In this paper, we propose a zero-suppressed variant of decision decomposable negation normal form (in short, decision-ZDNNF), which is strictly more succinct than ZBDDs. We then design a novel parallel algorithm, namely DXD, which constructs a decision-ZDNNF representing the set of all exact covers. Furthermore, we improve DXD by dynamically updating connected components. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved DXD algorithm outperforms all of state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出决策-ZDNNF作为比ZBDD更简洁的表示形式，设计并行算法DXD构建精确覆盖的决策-ZDNNF表示，并通过动态更新连通分量进行改进，实验证明改进DXD优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 精确覆盖问题是NP难问题，在AI领域有广泛应用。现有DXZ算法使用零抑制二叉决策图(ZBDD)计数精确覆盖，但ZBDD的表达能力有限，需要更简洁的表示形式来提高算法效率。
AI.method: 1. 提出决策-ZDNNF（零抑制决策可分解否定范式），作为比ZBDD更简洁的表示形式；2. 设计并行算法DXD，构建表示所有精确覆盖的决策-ZDNNF；3. 改进DXD算法，通过动态更新连通分量来优化性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，改进后的DXD算法在性能上优于所有现有最先进方法，证明了决策-ZDNNF表示形式的优越性和动态连通分量更新策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 决策-ZDNNF是比ZBDD更简洁的精确覆盖表示形式，结合动态连通分量更新的DXD算法在解决精确覆盖问题上具有显著优势，为AI领域的相关应用提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: Learning to Draw ASCII Improves Spatial Reasoning in Language Models
summary: When faced with complex spatial problems, humans naturally sketch layouts to organize their thinking, and the act of drawing further sharpens their understanding. In this work, we ask whether a similar principle holds for Large Language Models (LLMs): can learning to construct explicit visual layouts from spatial descriptions instill genuine spatial understanding? We introduce Text2Space, a dataset that pairs natural language descriptions with ground-truth ASCII grid layouts and spatial QA pairs, enabling us to separate failures in constructing spatial representations from failures in reasoning over them. We adopt ASCII because it is human-readable, operates entirely within the token space of language models, and encodes spatial relations in a structurally verifiable form. Our evaluation reveals a pronounced "Read-Write Asymmetry": LLMs interpret ASCII representations effectively but struggle to produce them from text, and these construction errors propagate to incorrect answers downstream. To address this limitation, we train models on layout construction (Text$\rightarrow$ASCII) and find that it significantly improves spatial reasoning from text alone, even without producing any ASCII at inference time. Combining construction with comprehension training further amplifies these gains. Crucially, these improvements transfer to three external spatial reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that, much as sketching sharpens human spatial thinking, learning to construct explicit layouts instills spatial understanding that generalizes beyond the training format.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Text2Space数据集，研究LLMs通过构建ASCII网格布局来学习空间理解的能力，发现存在"读写不对称"现象，并证明布局构建训练能显著提升空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 人类通过绘制草图来组织和深化空间理解，本研究探讨LLMs是否也能通过构建显式视觉布局来获得真正的空间理解能力。
AI.method: 引入Text2Space数据集，包含自然语言描述、ASCII网格布局和空间QA对；采用ASCII表示因其可读性、在语言模型token空间内运行且结构可验证；训练模型进行布局构建（文本→ASCII）和空间推理。
AI.result: 发现明显的"读写不对称"：LLMs能有效解释ASCII表示但难以从文本生成它们；布局构建训练显著提升纯文本空间推理能力；结合构建和理解训练效果更佳；改进能迁移到三个外部空间推理基准。
AI.conclusion: 如同草图绘制能提升人类空间思维，学习构建显式布局能培养LLMs的空间理解能力，且这种能力能泛化到训练格式之外。

title: DETR-ViP: Detection Transformer with Robust Discriminative Visual Prompts
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Visual prompted object detection enables interactive and flexible definition of target categories, thereby facilitating open-vocabulary detection. Since visual prompts are derived directly from image features, they often outperform text prompts in recognizing rare categories. Nevertheless, research on visual prompted detection has been largely overlooked, and it is typically treated as a byproduct of training text prompted detectors, which hinders its development. To fully unlock the potential of visual-prompted detection, we investigate the reasons why its performance is suboptimal and reveal that the underlying issue lies in the absence of global discriminability in visual prompts. Motivated by these observations, we propose DETR-ViP, a robust object detection framework that yields class-distinguishable visual prompts. On top of basic image-text contrastive learning, DETR-ViP incorporates global prompt integration and visual-textual prompt relation distillation to learn more discriminative prompt representations. In addition, DETR-ViP employs a selective fusion strategy that ensures stable and robust detection. Extensive experiments on COCO, LVIS, ODinW, and Roboflow100 demonstrate that DETR-ViP achieves substantially higher performance in visual prompt detection compared to other state-of-the-art counterparts. A series of ablation studies and analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed improvements and shed light on the underlying reasons for the enhanced detection capability of visual prompts.

AI.tldr: DETR-ViP：通过全局提示集成和视觉-文本提示关系蒸馏提升视觉提示目标检测性能的框架，解决了视觉提示缺乏全局区分性的问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉提示目标检测虽然能灵活定义目标类别且在识别稀有类别上优于文本提示，但相关研究被忽视，通常仅作为文本提示检测器的副产品。研究发现视觉提示性能不佳的根本原因是缺乏全局区分性。
AI.method: 提出DETR-ViP框架：在基础图像-文本对比学习之上，引入全局提示集成和视觉-文本提示关系蒸馏来学习更具区分性的提示表示；采用选择性融合策略确保检测的稳定性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在COCO、LVIS、ODinW和Roboflow100数据集上的大量实验表明，DETR-ViP在视觉提示检测方面相比其他最先进方法取得了显著更高的性能。
AI.conclusion: DETR-ViP通过解决视觉提示缺乏全局区分性的问题，成功释放了视觉提示检测的潜力，消融研究和分析进一步验证了所提改进的有效性。

title: Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, the widely used Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) consistently suffers from entropy collapse, causing the policy to converge prematurely and lose diversity. Existing exploration methods introduce additional bias or variance during exploration, making it difficult to maintain optimization stability. We propose Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning (UEC-RL), a framework that provides targeted mechanisms for exploration and stabilization. UEC-RL activates more exploration on difficult prompts to search for potential and valuable reasoning trajectories. In parallel, a stabilizer prevents entropy from growing uncontrollably, thereby keeping training stable as the model consolidates reliable behaviors. Together, these components expand the search space when needed while maintaining robust optimization throughout training. Experiments on both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks show consistent gains over RL baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@$k$. On Geometry3K, UEC-RL achieves a 37.9\% relative improvement over GRPO, indicating that it sustains effective exploration without compromising convergence and underscoring UEC-RL as a key for scaling RL-based reasoning in large models. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/UEC-RL.

AI.tldr: UEC-RL提出统一熵控制框架，解决GRPO中的熵崩溃问题，通过针对性探索机制和稳定器在困难提示上增强探索，同时保持训练稳定性，在LLM和VLM推理任务上优于现有RL基线。
AI.motivation: 当前强化学习在提升大语言模型和视觉语言模型推理能力时，广泛使用的GRPO方法存在熵崩溃问题，导致策略过早收敛、失去多样性。现有探索方法在探索过程中引入额外偏差或方差，难以保持优化稳定性。
AI.method: 提出统一熵控制强化学习框架UEC-RL，包含两个核心组件：1) 在困难提示上激活更多探索，搜索潜在有价值的推理轨迹；2) 稳定器防止熵无限增长，在模型巩固可靠行为时保持训练稳定。两者协同在需要时扩展搜索空间，同时在整个训练过程中保持鲁棒优化。
